feature: hobin result hooks (review, stances, learning): the session registry
request: Move the result hooks that share hook-input.mjs onto the shared session registry, as hobin-feature did (docs/plans/2026-11-07-result-hooks-on-session-registry.md, option (a)). Q1: the hooks decide this session's results from shell command text, PreToolUse stamps, file mtimes, the transcript's birth time and git log dates, each an inference with known misses or false claims. Q2: the ledger and stamps live in os.tmpdir(). Q3: a result written by a shell command needs that inference; the procedures should start every result from a script or an edit tool instead.

condition_table.note: Which results Stop checks, and when the scripts refuse. Per plugin: review (.hobin-review, check-report.mjs new|check), stances (.hobin-stances, stances.mjs check), learning (.hobin-learning, output-contract.mjs new|check).
rows: SessionStart -> registry in the event cwd, start dir remembered; missed -> UserPromptSubmit creates it (Claude CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, Codex event cwd) (R1); a later hook cwd never moves it (R2)

script with a session id: registry found from cwd upward -> registers the absolute path (R3); none -> exit 2, nothing written or checked (R4); no session id -> proceeds unregistered (R5); --no-gate -> proceeds only where no registry is found, refused (exit 2) where one is (R5)
edit tools (Claude Write/Edit/MultiEdit, Codex apply_patch Add/Update/Move to) -> checked at once; results registered, other files not (R6)
Stop -> exactly the registry's files (R3, R7); missing -> reported (R8); three blocks in a row at most (R9); a registered file is judged as a result even when it no longer looks like one
shell-only writes and stances.mjs block -> nothing registered, nothing inferred (R13, R14)
check throws -> exit 1, never 2 (R10); no session_id -> PostToolUse still checks, Stop exits 0 (R11); SessionEnd and week-old pruning (R12)

decisions.question: How do the result hooks decide which files are this session's results?
decisions.decision: Only the session registry (core/shared/scripts/session-registry.mjs), filled by the skills' scripts and by edit tools; Stop checks exactly its files
decisions.reason: Shell-text parsing, stamps, mtimes, transcript times and git dating are inference with known misses or false claims (design 2026-11-07)

decisions.question: How is a result written only through shell redirection covered?
decisions.decision: Option (a): in the procedure. Review gets a starter (check-report.mjs new); learning and stances already start from or check with a script. No hook inference
decisions.reason: An obligation (option b) does not fit skills that write a file only when asked
decisions.revert: Add an obligation as in hobin-feature

decisions.question: Does stances.mjs block register its target?
decisions.decision: No: block writes no file, and the target may change only after approval; registering it would make Stop demand a file a non-interactive run must not create, or block on an outdated block the user has not approved replacing. check registers the proposal and, in step 5, the target
decisions.reason: The procedure says write nothing until approval
decisions.revert: Register the target in stances.mjs block and accept those blocks

decisions.question: Is --no-gate allowed where the registry is found?
decisions.decision: No: refused with exit 2 (the hooks are active). SKILL.md files never mention --no-gate; only the no-registry message explains it
decisions.reason: A model passed --no-gate preemptively in a Claude eval because SKILL.md mentioned it
decisions.revert: Accept --no-gate in registration() of the three scripts and update R5

decisions.question: What does a check that throws do?
decisions.decision: Exit 1 with an internal-error message, never 2 (unchanged)
decisions.reason: The model must not be sent back for the hook's own failure
decisions.revert: Exit 0 in runHook and update R10

decisions.question: Where does the review starter mark a report, and how does the hook recognize it?
decisions.decision: No marker in the report: the skeleton fails check-report.mjs (TODO: lines, no finding or No findings) and the registry, not the content, makes it a result; edit-tool writes are still recognized by a first line that is a finding or No findings
decisions.reason: A marker line would change the report format the scenarios and users read
decisions.revert: Add a marker line to SKELETON and to the report hook's recognition

decisions.question: Do scenario checks run the capability scripts as the session?
decisions.decision: No: scenario-check.mjs removes the session variables from command_passes and script_passes, as scenarios.mjs run does
decisions.reason: A grader is not the session; inside a session without the plugin it would be refused
decisions.revert: Pass process.env through in scenario-check.mjs and update R17

must_fix: a session shell command that creates a worktree or checkout and names a .md file still claimed every checked-out .md file through the cwd walk (reproduced: git worktree add -q wt -b side && cat wt/README.md -> Stop exit 2)
rounds.resolution: Git working-tree commands record nothing and the walk keeps only named files (E6); R17, R18 added; the same git rule added to the hobin-feature hook with F23

must_fix: the git rule matched git words anywhere in the command text (a here-document saying 'git reset', a commit message with 'am'), exempting the session's own invalid result
a command that both switched branches and wrote a result exempted the result
rounds.resolution: Replaced the command-text rule with the file's git state: a candidate tracked and unchanged from the commit is git's write; R19, R20, F24 added (each fails on the text rule)

must_fix: a result written and committed in the same command is tracked and unchanged, so the git rule dropped it unchecked
rounds.resolution: checkedOut now also needs the file's last commit to predate the call (or the session); R21 and F25 added and fail on the round-2 rule. This fix came after the third and last verification round, so no independent verifier has reviewed it

must_fix: E6 says ignored files count, but no scenario put a result in a git-ignored path (the code already counted it)
rounds.resolution: Review after the 0.5.1 release; it found no defect in the round-3 commit-time rule. R22 added here and F26 in the hobin-feature record

Redesigned to the session registry (design 2026-11-07, option (a)); PreToolUse/PostToolUseFailure hooks, shell-text parsing, stamps, mtime/transcript/git dating and the tmpdir ledger removed; scenarios renumbered to tests/result-hooks-registry.test.mjs. Mutation checks: Stop ignoring the registry fails R2, R3, R7, R8, R9; Stop reading the hook cwd fails R2; scripts proceeding without a registry fail R4; --no-gate accepted where a registry is found fails R5. Not reviewed by an independent verifier yet.
